BiblicalUsage: Temach was one of the Nethinim, the temple servants who returned from exile with Zerubbabel. The children of Temach are named among the Nethinim in the list of those who came up from Babylon, and again in Nehemiah's list.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Nethinim are part of the people who came home, and Temach's children are named among them.
